candidates.title: `ollama create --quantize` from safetensors leaves the unquantized F16 blob in `blobs/` (unreferenced, never removed)
candidates.snippet: ## What happened  Every successful `ollama create <name> --quantize q4_K_M` from a safetensors directory leaves a ~50 GB blob in `~/.ollama/models/blobs` that no manifest references. `ollama rm <name>` does not remove it (it only removes layers in the manifest). After 12 imports of a 26B model I had 948 GB in `~/.ollama/models` while `ollama list` summed to 188 GB — 69 unreferenced blobs, 830 GB.
